execution: No tests, builds, native processes, host queries, Git or tracked edits by this agent.
red_reason: The provider header/API is absent before its implementation patch. No production source registration is added before the actual RED.
behavior_groups: Invalid geometry, source identity, epoch, shape, finite PCM, overlap, gaps and final markers leave publication unchanged; accepted payload is copied.
Malformed, oversized and out-of-position reads preserve their destination and consumer position.
All 72 slots remain occupied until every view copies each slot; Full and a failed terminal publication do not consume producer state.
One 280800-frame converted hop fits as 69 packets, preserving full-size edges, partitioned rendering, headroom and exact EOF.
A full paused ring seek releases stale storage; four notifications coalesce and retain a packet published after the first; later same-position retries invalidate old epochs.
A producer job explicitly withheld across a seek cannot publish its old captured request, and the new epoch recovers.
Real SPSC publication with repeated render-owned seeks retains coherent request origins and exact asymmetric sample order.
Actual StemBankSource and RenderCore preserve muted-role alignment, prefix-only shortages, independent master/cue gains, peer/output clocks and exact EOF.

source_reviews.implementation_author: All eight groups match the frozen API and EOF/coalescing contract; no concrete oracle mismatch reported.
source_reviews.independent_m0_agent: No concrete oracle/lifetime/race blocker; actual four-view release and sample checks are meaningful.

limits: The deterministic in-flight test withholds producer work before publication. Concurrent stress does not prove every instruction-level interleaving or force the post-check stale-slot race.
This is a pure fixed 48 kHz provider test. It does not integrate Python, a resampler, workers, cancellation supervision, fallback policy, LiveSession, GUI or physical audio.
No latency, thermal, sustained playback, musical acceptance or whole-product qualification claim.
